sentences.en: The equation which expressed " Deslandres' law " was only given by its author as an approximate one.

sentences.en: But that it may be given by the ordinary diatomic molecule is exemplified by oxygen, which gives in thick layers by absorption one of the typical sets of bands which were used by Deslandres and others to investigate the laws of distribution of frequencies.
